usdt_usd_ref.label: GIẢ ĐỊNH BÁO CÁO — USDT=USD 1:1 (reporting assumption only, not a real conversion)
usdt_usd_ref.monitoring: MANUAL/PROCEDURAL (no automated rate fetch in this build): operator/dashboard must surface a DATA_WARNING row if |market USDTUSD - 1| > 0.5%; rate is never silently re-marked; shadow-only conversion, NOT a real broker balance transfer

capital_model: SLEEVE_FENCED: ONE portfolio book of $100,000 USD-eq split into two declared sleeve capitals; PnL/risk aggregate on the single book; each sleeve's sizing law applies to its OWN fenced capital so existing frozen sizing pins keep their semantics.

sleeves.sizing_law: 1.5 lot/pair/signal (frozen in FX cycle) applies against sleeve capital $50,000; cost gap DISCLOSED: journal has no commission/slippage/funding fields (spread is implicit in opposite-side fills) — all FX PnL is GROSS/HYPOTHETICAL until A1-controls GO
sleeves.open_gap: A1-controls (short-beta control, cost fields, USD-exposure report) DRAFT_FOR_OWNER_GO

sleeves.sizing_law: A2 sizing B (realized fraction 0.99946) applies to the SLEEVE capital of $50,000 (re-expression required by PORTFOLIO_MIGRATION_COMPAT §2 — A2 as activated defines fraction on the sleeve's own book; fencing preserves pin semantics); fill law A (first completed 15m bar after H4 decision); cost law 6 bps/side with cost_regime_digest boundary at T_act=2026-09-25T03:57:05Z
sleeves.open_gap: A2 remaining phases + tests per its own gate (other lane's authority — read-only here)

allocation.anti_optimization_note: Equal 50/50 by construction (only performance-independent split available for two sleeves). NOT tuned on observed epoch-1 PnL (owner order). Changing weights after activation requires a new amendment.

capital_rule.priority_rationale: Declared fixed order: USD sleeve first (fx/rate accounting stability), then crypto. NOT performance-based; frozen before any epoch-2 PnL exists.
activation_gate_fields: rule_digest (sha256 of this capital_rule block at freeze)
laws: R1 risk-reducing closes are always allowed regardless of caps
R2 new risk processed strictly in priority_order at the same decision timestamp
R3 if aggregate gross USD-eq exposure after a fill would exceed cap_total_pct of portfolio equity OR the sleeve's class cap, scale that fill down proportionally (min of the two headrooms)
R4 if the scaled unit is below min_unit (FX: 0.10 lot; crypto: 10 USDT notional) the signal is BLOCKED and a blocked_signals row is recorded
R5 caps bind NEW signals only; the activation-carried book (per approved open-position law) is grandfathered and shown as 'carried exposure'

caps_proposal_from_sizing_audit.status: PROPOSAL — numbers first proposed 2026-09-25 BEFORE any epoch-2 PnL existed (sizing audit); deliberately NOT re-picked after seeing PnL; owner approves at GO

adapters.note: Read-model adapters exist for these two sleeves only. Adding a strategy later = explicit entry here + a written adapter + owner GO; the app NEVER auto-discovers or auto-mounts sleeves.

open_position_law_options.FLAT_START: At T* every open position is left in its EPOCH-1 book; epoch-2 sleeve books start flat. Epoch-1 residual exposure is displayed separately until the old books go flat. No force-close of any worker book (workers keep managing epoch-1 positions under their own frozen laws).
open_position_law_options.REOPEN_AT_MARK: At T* each open position gets (a) an epoch-boundary CLOSING row in the boundary manifest (mark price, MTM PnL booked to epoch-1) and (b) an epoch-2 OPENING row with the same symbol/direction/qty and entry = T* mark. Exposure continuity; PnL splits exactly at the mark; epoch-2 cost basis is the T* mark (the epoch-1 accrued PnL stays in epoch-1). No cost-basis transfer across epochs; boundary rows make the split auditable.

cutover_blocked_note: CUTOVER IS BLOCKED until: (1) owner types the GO phrase with T_STAR + OPEN_POSITION_LAW (allocation EQUAL_2WAY is the only option), (2) sha256 manifest of epoch-1 source files is written, (3) independent review of amendment A4-v2 is recorded in REVIEW_LOG.md, (4) BANDRIDGE mount re-expression (sleeve-fenced sizing B) is owner-accepted. Nothing in this repo activates itself. Gate B (decommission old dashboards) is a SEPARATE owner GO with its own inventory.
